scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/cli packages/react && npm run build -w @thixo/bench
scripts.test: npm run test -w @thixo/core -w @thixo/cli -w @thixo/site -w @thixo/bench && npm run test:scripts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/cli packages/react packages/bench && tsc -p packages/bench/tsconfig.dev.json && tsc -p scripts && tsc -p packages/site
